name: Priit Mihkelson Turtle Defense System
description: Priit Mihkelson's Protecting & Generating Dynamic Offense From The Turtle covers defensive posture, hook and harness problems, chokes and exits from turtle.
summary: Protecting & Generating Dynamic Offense From The Turtle by Priit Mihkelson covers posture, responses to common attacks, and returns to guard or standing.
overview: Priit Mihkelson's course focuses on the turtle position, from neck and elbow positioning to dealing with hooks, harnesses and specific attacks. It includes turtle situations arising against over-under, toreando and knee-slide passing, as well as clock chokes, front-headlock submissions and crucifix threats. The final volume covers exits, including spin escapes, returns to guard, Granby movement and standing.

products.title: Protecting & Generating Dynamic Offense From The Turtle
products.blurb: A four-volume turtle course covering posture, attacking threats and exits to guard or standing.
products.best_for: Grapplers who regularly reach turtle and want both defensive options and exits.

guide.display_title: Priit Mihkelson: Turtle Defense and Exits

fits: You often end up in turtle during passing exchanges and want instruction on its defensive problems.
You want a turtle course that includes both responses to attacks and ways to return to guard or standing.

includes: Turtle posture, neck and elbow principles, pushing and pulling pressure, and hook management.
Harnesses, clock chokes, passing situations, wrestling tilts, D'Arce, anaconda, guillotine and crucifix threats.
Hip-pull and harness counters, spin escapes, guard returns, Granby movement and standing from turtle.
limits: The course centers on turtle and transitions out of it; it is not a broad mount, side-control and rear-mount escape series.
